deepseek-copilot.walkthrough.description: Based on DeepSeek V4 v0.7.1 — route Copilot Chat to multiple backends via proxy_configs.json.
deepseek-copilot.walkthrough.configurePr:
Create `~/.vscode/proxy_configs.json` (use placeholders only — no real IPs or API keys).
[Reload Config](command:unified-proxy-copilot.reloadConfig)
Pick a model in Copilot Chat

Select your configured entry under the **Unified Proxy** vendor.
[Open Language Models](command:workbench.action.chat.manage)

deepseek-copilot.config.title: Unified Proxy Copilot
deepseek-copilot.config.baseUrl.descript: (Legacy) DeepSeek API base URL. Not needed when using proxy_configs.json.
deepseek-copilot.config.proxyBaseUrl.des: (Legacy) Unified proxy base URL. Not needed when using proxy_configs.json.
deepseek-copilot.config.maxTokens.descri: (Legacy) Max output tokens. Use per-proxy max_output_tokens in the config file instead.
deepseek-copilot.config.experimental.sta:
**Experimental** — see DeepSeek V4 for Copilot Chat v0.7.1.

Use [Configure Tools](command:workbench.action.chat.configureTools) to manage your tool list.
deepseek-copilot.config.debugMode.descri:
Diagnostic level. Same behavior as DeepSeek V4 v0.7.1.

- **Minimal** — token usage only
- **Metadata** — shareable metadata logs
- **Verbose** — full request dumps (sensitive)
deepseek-copilot.config.modelIdOverrides: (Legacy) Override API model IDs. Use model_id in proxy_configs.json instead.
deepseek-copilot.config.visionModel.desc: Vision proxy model ID when supports_images=1. See DeepSeek V4 v0.7.1.
deepseek-copilot.config.visionPrompt.des: Prompt used by the vision proxy to describe images.
